subject.title: WhatsApp pairing can stick at Logging in until gateway restart finalizes 515 recovery

question: Should the active WhatsApp phone-code PR be required to prove and close this 515 manual-restart recovery behavior, or should this issue remain a separate WhatsApp recovery tracker after phone-code login lands?
rationale: The open PRs address the missing phone-code entrypoint, but this issue documents a distinct finalization behavior that the PR discussions treat as adjacent and not fully proven.

options.title: Require Proof In Phone-Code PR
options.body: Ask the active phone-code branch to include live proof that 515 finalization no longer needs a manual gateway restart before closing this issue.

options.title: Keep Separate 515 Tracker
options.body: Allow phone-code login to land separately and leave this issue open for a narrower WhatsApp-owned recovery fix with live proof.

recommendation.title: Require Proof In Phone-Code PR
recommendation.body: Ask the active phone-code branch to include live proof that 515 finalization no longer needs a manual gateway restart before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice crosses public CLI, plugin/channel API, docs, and WhatsApp auth-session boundaries, and steipete has recent WhatsApp login history plus likely routing ownership for the API decision.
